meta.title: Replace emotion with CSS modules across Express.js and Next.js applications
meta.body_summary: Replace emotion styling with CSS modules throughout the Simorgh codebase, claiming improved performance and reduced bundle size by eliminating runtime CSS-in-JS overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot attempted large-scale emotion→CSS modules migration but left ~400 TS errors and many unconverted complex components; maintainer engaged but PR closed due to incomplete work and prolonged inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2361 changed lines across 199 files, this is a large, codebase-wide refactor. It is consistent with the closed outcome given the incomplete conversion and leftover TypeScript errors.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer eagerterrier noted remaining TypeScript errors and requested conversion of ThemeProvider and complex page components; Copilot reduced errors from 1000+ to ~400 but left many emotion-dependent components.
review_details.performance_claim: Replacing emotion with CSS modules removes runtime overhead and reduces bundle size.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed likely due to incomplete migration and prolonged inactivity (closed after ~1 year). No explicit rejection comment, but maintainer's request for remaining files indicates expectation not met.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large-scale migration across hundreds of files with complex dynamic styling patterns exceeds agent's ability to complete without human iteration; minor errors and incomplete conversion persist after multiple rounds.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer eagerterrier reviewed CI results (TypeScript errors) and manually inspected remaining emotion files, requesting specific conversions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks or before/after metrics provided; only narrative claims about runtime overhead and bundle size reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merging; maintainer attempted to guide agent through additional conversions but the effort remained incomplete.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced emotion styling with CSS modules across the Simorgh codebase: removed emotion dependencies, converted 200+ components from emotion `css`/`styled` to CSS modules with local scoping, added webpack configuration for CSS modules, and cleaned up unused imports. The change spans both Express.js (`src/`) and Next.js (`ws-nextjs-app/`) apps.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Also includes dependency updates in yarn.lock and cache changes; many component files were bulk-updated.
change_trajectory: Initial plan and exploration of emotion usage.
Set up CSS modules configuration and convert initial component group (LiveLabel).
Bulk convert all emotion components to CSS modules across codebase.
Fix css prop usage, clean up emotion imports and configurations.
Final fixes for duplicate className attributes and remaining emotion imports.
Fix TypeScript errors: add Jest types, CSS modules support, remove unused emotion files, reducing errors from 1000+ to ~400.
Remove unused emotion styles files and fix React import issues.
Convert MediaArticlePage from emotion to CSS modules.
Add ArticlePage CSS module placeholder and assess remaining emotion usage.
Maintainer requests further conversions; Copilot reports remaining 30 emotion files; PR eventually closed without merge after ~1 year.
